title: analysis
description: Orchestrator end-of-run summary written to analysis.json once the run completes.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for the run (format: run-YYYYMMDD-HHMM).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the analysis was written.

lanes_executed.description: List of lane identifiers that were executed during the run.

review_findings.description: Populated only when overall_status is 'review_unresolved'. Each item describes an unresolved code-review finding.

line_range.description: e.g. '42-57'. Omit when line range is unavailable.

recommendations.description: Populated only with --self-improve. Ranked improvement suggestions from the improvement analyzer.

run_directory.description: Absolute path to the run artifact directory under the user-level Copilot directory.
